_publications._context: Human lymphoblastoid cell line derived from an individual with NF1 (blood, EBV-transformed with cyclosporin A per Anderson & Gusella 1984). Carries NF1 variant c.3360dupT, duplication in exon 26 (20) (p.V1121fs*1), predicted to introduce a premature termination codon. Clinical data are available for this individual. Synapse syn74552629; James Walker's group, Massachusetts General Hospital.

basicInfo.description: Human lymphoblastoid cell line derived via EBV transformation from the blood of an individual with NF1, carrying the NF1 variant c.3360dupT (p.V1121fs*1) (Duplication in exon 26 (20)).
